source.note: wide broadcast shot from behind the bowler; camera zooms in during the run-up; cuts to batter close-up after delivery (~12.6 s)

processed.crop: square window around bowler box; centre and side smoothed with gaussian (zero lag); side = max(w,h)*1.30, floor 1.15*max(w,h)
processed.resampling: Lanczos4 upscale from source pixels (source player only ~90 to 170 px tall)
processed.tracker: IoU/centre-distance chain seeded on the bowler (yellow kit) from yolox_l person detections
